{{Quote|Didn't you tell me that Lando was out there, mining asteroids or something?''"<br />"''He's out there. Pair of planets called Dubrillion and Destrillion, near an asteroid system he modestly named Lando's Folly.|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]|<ref name="VP">''[[The New Jedi Order: Vector Prime]]''</ref>}}
The '''Dubrillion system''' contained several planets, of which [[Dubrillion/Legends|Dubrillion]] and [[Destrillion]] were some. [[Lando's Folly]] and ''[[Belt-Runner I]]'' were also located in this [[Star system/Legends|star system]]. It was located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim's]] [[Myto sector/Legends|Myto sector]].
